title: fix: add missing Field.json() helper
body:
`@objectstack/service-realtime` fails to build because `Field.json()` doesn't exist. The `json` type is defined in the `FieldType` enum but had no corresponding factory helper on the `Field` object.

- **`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`**: Add `Field.json()` helper, matching the pattern of other simple field helpers

```typescript
// Now works in sys-presence.object.ts (and anywhere else)
metadata: Field.json({
  label: 'Metadata',
  description: 'Arbitrary JSON metadata',
}),
```

- **`content/docs/references/`**: Include pending doc updates for `tool`/`skill` metadata types and agent `skills`/`permissions` fields that were added to source but not yet reflected in reference docs
